The '''Mushroom Desert''' is one of the 2 islands in [[The Farming Islands]] that is located north from {{Zone|The Barn}}, and has items unique to the area.

{{ZoneText|A desert with a lot of plant life.}}

== Location ==
The '''Mushroom Desert''' is part of [[The Farming Islands]]. It is accessed by using the north warp pad at [[The Barn]] on the top of the terraces. The player needs to reach {{skl|Farming V}} to access to this location.

== Zones ==
The Mushroom Desert is the only public island where players can get [[Sand]] and [[Cactus|Cacti]] for their [[Collections]]. The island is also divided into multiple areas with each one of them serving a different purpose in the game:
{{:Locations/Mushroom Desert}}

== Trivia ==
* The Mushroom Desert is the location with the fifth most [[NPC]]s, after the [[Hub Island|Hub]], [[Crimson Isle]], [[Dwarven Mines]], and the [[Moonglade Marsh]].
* The Mushroom Desert and [[The Barn]] are in the same server. This means the player can travel between the islands without using [[Launch Pad (structure)|Launch Pad]]s through items like the {{Item|Grappling Hook}} and {{Item|Aspect of the End}}.
* On the original Mushroom Desert island, there was a launch pad that said "{{mctxt|e|Coming later this year!}}" located at {{Coordinates|246|99|-412}}.
